FLORIDA INFLUENZA SURVEILLANCE REPORT (Florida Flu Review)
Season: 2021-22 | MMWR Week 10 (3/6/22 - 3/12/22)
Source: Florida Dept. of Health Flu Review PDF (charts read directly) + CDC NHSN open data. Provisional.

==================================================================
SUMMARY
==================================================================
During this week, statewide influenza activity trend was increasing; the predominant strain was Influenza A (H3); 1 influenza/ILI outbreak(s) were reported.

==================================================================
1. EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT & OUTPATIENT ACTIVITY
==================================================================
- ED visits with a flu discharge diagnosis (ESSENCE-FL): increasing (slightly) vs prior 3-season avg.
- ED / urgent care visits with ILI: decreasing.
- NSSP exact ED influenza %: not available (CDC NSSP state series starts Oct 2022).

==================================================================
2. VIRUS CHARACTERIZATION
==================================================================
- Predominant strain: Influenza A (H3).
- The percent of influenza-positive laboratory results remained low.

==================================================================
3. REGIONAL ED FLU ACTIVITY
==================================================================
- Region 1 (Northwest): stable
- Region 2 (North Central): stable
- Region 3 (Northeast): stable
- Region 4 (Central West): stable
- Region 5 (Central East): stable
- Region 6 (Southwest): increasing
- Region 7 (Southeast): increasing

==================================================================
4. OUTBREAKS
==================================================================
- This week: 1 influenza/ILI outbreak(s) reported, 0 influenza-associated, 0 with severe outcomes.

==================================================================
5. HOSPITALIZATIONS & SEVERE OUTCOMES
==================================================================
- NHSN new influenza admissions: 47 (0.21 per 100k).
- NHSN patients hospitalized with influenza this week: 35.14.
- NHSN season-to-date admissions: 1334.
- Pneumonia & influenza (P&I) deaths: decreasing.
- Influenza-associated pediatric deaths: n/a.

the FL Flu Review charts, maps, and tables. Hospitalization counts are CDC NHSN.
NSSP ED influenza % is unavailable before Oct 2022. 2021-22 used the older 17-page layout.
